blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Edmonds. No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Edmonds condos and townhomes in Burnaby: 85 listed at the end of October 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. That makes Edmonds number 3 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings. Houses in Edmonds have their own page; this page is only about attached homes.

blocks.text: Condo and townhome listings in Edmonds fell from 101 in June to 85 in October (−15.8%), while 63 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.5% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condo and townhome listings.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Edmonds' plan area is bounded by Imperial Street to the north, Canada Way to the east, 10th Avenue to the south, and Gilley Avenue/Marine Drive to the west, per the Edmonds Community Plan's plan-area boundary section — all lands inside that boundary are considered part of Edmonds under the plan.

The Edmonds Community Plan was adopted in March 2025, and Edmonds is one of Burnaby's four town centres; the plan area is about 908 acres with three nodes — the Town Centre at Kingsway and Edmonds Street, the Station node at Edmonds Station, and Southgate City — and six districts.

The plan's three nodes are where the condo stock concentrates: Kingsway corridor mid- and high-rises at the Town Centre node, towers at the Station node, and the Southgate City master plan at the south node.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: the housing stock

items.t: What is confirmed on the City record is the shape of incoming stock: the City's major-projects list shows Edmonds plan-area applications as high-rise market strata towers with podiums, low-rise strata buildings, and non-market rental buildings in the same projects — for example the Southgate City Gateway phases combine two high-rise towers, podiums and two low-rise buildings.

One tenure trap is on the Kingsway corridor itself: a large tower on the corridor can be non-market rental rather than strata, so a Kingsway address alone does not establish that a building sells units — tenure must be checked building by building.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Edmonds Community Plan (adopted March 2025) is the current plan for this ground, and Burnaby 2050, adopted December 9, 2025, takes precedence over older community-plan land-use maps where they conflict — so pre-2025 Edmonds plan wording is not the current direction for a Kingsway lot.

Zoning for the corridor stock is in the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026 (Bylaw No. 14815): its district list runs Low-Rise Apartment (R3, R4), Mid-Rise Apartment (R5, R6) and High-Rise Apartment (R7, R8), with a Townhouse District (R2) for ground-oriented forms.

An Edmonds strata cannot enforce a long-term rental-restriction bylaw: the Province states that as of November 24, 2022 all strata residential rental-restriction bylaws are invalid, only a 55-or-older age bylaw is allowed, and short-term rental bylaws remain allowed.

The strata budget rule to check on a Form B is the contingency reserve fund (CRF): the Province states a strata must contribute a minimum of 10% of its annual operating fund to the CRF when it approves its budget (from November 1, 2023).

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Edmonds plan names a creek daylighting move: the plan's big moves include supporting efforts to daylight Powerhouse Creek as future development occurs, and enhancing parks and trails into a blue-green space network — a creek fact that affects lots near the corridor, not only ravine lots.

Byrne Creek runs south through the area: the Province's dike list names a Byrne Creek dike, 4.35 kilometres, administered by the City of Burnaby — the document a buyer of a lot near Byrne Creek Ravine Park starts from.

Townhouse-form stock exists in Edmonds but is not this page's product: Mosaic Homes' townhouse project on Bevan Street and Stride Avenue addresses (REZ #22-04) combines market and below-market rental townhouses and reached Final Adoption January 27, 2026 — it belongs to the Edmonds townhomes page, and is named here once.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Southgate City — Gateway Neighbourhood PH2 (REZ #22-31B, Southgate City Homes Ltd.), portion of 7201 11th Avenue: two high-rise market strata buildings, a low-rise strata building and a low-rise non-market rental building; 819 market strata homes and 115 non-market rental homes. Status: Final Adoption March 11, 2025, on the City list updated October 27, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

Southgate City — Gateway Neighbourhood PH1 and G3/G4 PH2 (REZ #22-30, Southgate City Homes Ltd.), portion of 7201 11th Avenue: two high-rise towers with podiums and two low-rise buildings; 462 market strata homes (G5/G6 PH1) and 415 market strata homes (G3/G4 PH2), plus a non-market rental building. Status: First and Second Reading January 28, 2025 (as of November 3, 2026).

Kingsway and Edmonds Conceptual Master Plan (REZ #20-32, Aplin and Martin Consultants Ltd.), 7252 and 7282 Kingsway and 7255 Edmonds Street: concept for the southwest corner of Kingsway and Edmonds Street; 1,076 market strata homes and 233 market median rental homes. Status: Second Reading June 5, 2023 (as of November 3, 2026) (status is over 12 months old — check current).
6535 Kingsway (REZ #25-09, Intracorp Kingsway Balmoral LP): 12-storey mixed-use building, 290 rental units. Status: Third Reading October 27, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: The condo utility figure is the City's 2026 Multiple Family Dwelling line: water $374.54 and sewer use $436.00 per year, with a 5% discount if the full payment is received before the due date.

The City states a change in how the sewer parcel tax is billed: it appears on the property tax notice each May, and starting in 2027 it moves to the utility notice — a billing-location change a strata owner will see in 2027, not a new charge.
The 2026 financial plan held water at 0% and raised sewer about $14 for a condo.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: getting around

items.t: Edmonds Station (Expo Line) is the rapid-transit anchor for the Station node; the City is also running an Edmonds Town Centre Cycling Network project, listed on its projects page, which is the document for street-by-street cycling changes.

Route 116 runs between Metrotown Station and Edmonds Station via Griffiths Drive, Southridge Drive and 18th Avenue, which is the bus a Southgate City or 18th Avenue owner uses to reach either station.

Kingsway is the corridor arterial: the Edmonds plan's big moves include transforming Kingsway into a safer, more pedestrian-friendly boulevard and Edmonds Street into a mixed-use Character Street, which is the plan context for corridor construction in coming years.

blocks.text: Edmonds Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Creek and ravine lots carry the area's lot-level check: Byrne Creek and Powerhouse Creek cross the plan area, the Province's dike list records a 4.35-kilometre Byrne Creek dike administered by the City of Burnaby, and the Edmonds plan proposes daylighting Powerhouse Creek — a buyer near either creek should confirm the lot's streamside and flood status with the City before subjects are removed.

Tenure is the building-level check on Kingsway: the corridor holds both strata towers and non-market rental towers, and the City's project list is the fastest public check of what a given address was approved as.

For any strata purchase, the depreciation report and Form B are the systems check: the Province tracks updated depreciation report requirements effective July 1, 2024, so a report dated before that was prepared under the older requirements.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Edmonds?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 85 condos and townhomes listed in Edmonds. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Edmonds a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Edmonds had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Edmonds from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 63 condos and townhomes sold in Edmonds over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
